_comment: GLOBAL config — install at ~/.codex-channel-octo/config.json. Holds SHARED defaults + the list of bots to run. It does NOT hold a botToken: each bot's token lives in ~/.codex-channel-octo/<id>/config.json (see config.bot.example.json). The directory containing THIS file is the baseDir; every bot is a self-contained subtree at <baseDir>/<id>/{config.json, SOUL.md, data/, workspace/, codex-home/}, all auto-created. Per-bot dirs are NOT configurable — they are always derived from baseDir + id, so a bot can never escape its subtree.
_comment_bots: Which bots to run. Each entry's `id` selects its subtree <baseDir>/<id>/ and its per-bot config.json. A single bot is just one entry, conventionally id 'default'. Per-bot config.json overrides anything here.
_comment_group_config_dir: Optional directory of per-group instruction files (<groupId>.md), injected as trusted project instructions (AGENTS.md). Operator-controlled — keep it OUTSIDE every bot's workspace (the agent can write there). Omit to disable.

sdk._comment_codex_base_url: Optional self-hosted Codex provider base URL (e.g. a private gateway). Passed to new Codex({ baseUrl }). Must be https:// (or http://localhost for dev) — SSRF-validated at boot. Omit to use codex's configured default.
sdk._comment_codex_api_key: Optional API key for the Codex provider, passed to new Codex({ apiKey }). Alternatively authenticate per-bot via `codex login` against the bot's codex-home.
sdk._comment_sandbox: SECURITY: IM input is untrusted. sandboxMode defaults to 'read-only' (safe Q&A / code review). To let the bot edit files you must set BOTH allowWorkspaceWrite=true AND sandboxMode='workspace-write'. 'danger-full-access' is rejected outright.
sdk._comment_approval: approvalPolicy: never | on-request | on-failure | untrusted. Default 'never' (headless — no human to answer). The real boundary is sandboxMode, not this.
sdk._comment_effort: modelReasoningEffort: minimal | low | medium | high | xhigh. Default 'medium'. NOTE: 'minimal' conflicts with web search.
sdk._comment_network: networkAccessEnabled / webSearchEnabled default false (untrusted IM input). Enable deliberately.
sdk._comment_tool_progress: Set toolProgress=true to post redacted '🔧 <action>…' progress notices as codex works (command/file/tool — never stdout, diff, or full args). Off by default.

_comment_mention_free: group_ids listed here process every text message without requiring an @bot mention.
_comment_workbench: Web workbench (#24): built-in read-only ops console served by the gateway process on 0.0.0.0:<listenPort> (upstream reaches it via the docker host-gateway bridge IP). Auth = the caller's Octo `token` header, checked against <apiUrl>/v1/user/current; a user may only access bots they own. Static UI from web/workbench/dist. Set enabled=false to turn it off.
_comment_public_base_url: Optional EXTERNALLY reachable base URL of the workbench web UI (absolute http/https). When set, after a turn that produced/modified files in the session sandbox the bot posts a delivery message (type-17 interactive card, plain-text fallback) to the originating conversation with deep links <publicBaseUrl>/workspace?bot=<uid>&session=<hex>&path=<file>. Omit to disable the delivery-card hook.
_comment_delivery_card: Delivery-card feature flags (#32). enabled omitted = true (hook on whenever publicBaseUrl is set); set {"enabled": false} to keep deep links configured without auto-posting delivery messages.
_comment_media_allowed_hosts: Optional extra hosts allowed to serve INBOUND media (images/files). Normally the media CDN host is prefetched at startup from the Octo STS upload-credentials response — but that endpoint fails on Octo deployments without COS/STS configured (e.g. MinIO-backed), and then EVERY inbound image URL is rejected and the agent only sees a '[图片]' placeholder. Declare the real media host(s) here (bare host, port included if non-default, no scheme/path/wildcard) to enable inbound images without depending on that prefetch. The bridge logs the rejected host at WARN when a media URL is dropped, so you can copy the exact value from the log.
_comment_runtime: Agent runtime backend. 'codex' (default when omitted) drives OpenAI Codex via the SDK; 'lumo' drives a Lumo Work server over its HTTP SSE API. A per-bot config.json may override this per bot.
_comment_lumo: Lumo Work backend settings — used ONLY when runtime='lumo'. baseUrl must be an absolute http(s) origin and passes the same loopback/SSRF policy as apiUrl (https to a non-private host, or http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1). idleTimeoutMs resets on every received stream byte (default 30000); maxTurnMs is the absolute per-turn ceiling (default 900000).
